name: -- HEXARIS [26.2+] --
description:
💚 Hexaris is a claims-based Survival SMP built for all players with just enough risk to keep things interesting. 💚

⭐ Claim your land and protect what you’ve built, but if you leave a base or your items unclaimed, they’re free game. Build smart, stay active, and watch your back.

💎 Team up with friends and unlock proximity effects while you play together.

⛏️ Stick close and earn effects like Haste to speed up mining and building. Whether you’re grinding resources or building out your claims, teamwork pays off!

⚔️ Test your skills in the Arena with full kits, leaderboard prizes each month. Head back to Spawn to run the Parkour course. More courses are already in the works, so there’s always a new challenge waiting.

💜 Quality of life features keep the experience smooth: Random Teleport, Homes, Player Warps, and a full economy system so you can trade, set up shops, and progress at your own pace.

🌻 Hexaris is a community-focused SMP where you decide how hard you want to play. Build a safe base with your team, risk it all for unclaimed loot, compete in the Arena, or just hang out and explore. New players are ALWAYS welcome!!

💚 Java & Bedrock supported 💚

IP: hexaris.cc (Bedrock Port: 19132)

Discord: discord.gg/jTHCYja9hS

🎮 Grab your gear, bring your friends, and make your mark - see you on Hexaris!
